method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.answer: Constructs WeaponImage and WeaponAmmoCount/ClipInfo, binding each to the entire parent model. dwGrappleWeapon updates the image only on nonnil values via GetHudImageFromItemIndex and RegisterImage. Nil does not clear the previous image. Registers close, optional PostLoadFunc, then returns self.

summary.answer: Initializes tankState only if absent, constructs ammo/storage/weapon presentation layers, and binds StorageSlot to WarzoneInventoryGlobal.storage and both ammo children to CurrentWeapon. GoldenBullet tests HUDItems.goldenBullet==1, with a matching validation subscription. After child IDs, existing close and optional PostLoadFunc it returns self. It does not produce ammunition, armor or golden-bullet state.

summary.answer: Constructs CoD.AmmoWidgetWZ_WeaponImage from the displayed menu/controller/layout arguments. Creates PowerWeaponDrainGadget3 as CoD.AmmoWidget_PowerWeaponDrain.new, PowerWeaponDrainGadget2 as CoD.AmmoWidget_PowerWeaponDrain.new, WeaponImage as LUI.UIFixedAspectRatioImage.new, HeroAbilityUseString as CoD.AmmoWidgetWZ_WeaponName.new. Connects 4 model/path references; the model subscription effects below specify which receiver changes and under which nil/value guard. Installs 1 event/action/override bindings; each callback keeps its captured controller/menu/widget references and executes only on its bound delivery. The ordered effect contract retains every property, model, visual, navigation, callback and return mutation in source order; returning self is not proof the original game loads this widget.
